name: im-a-pm
description: Agent skill that maps a codebase as business flows for product managers.

scripts.examples: node examples/shop/make-map.mjs && node skills/im-a-pm/scripts/im-a-pm.mjs render examples/shop/flows.json --base examples/shop/base.json --out examples/shop/index.html && node skills/im-a-pm/scripts/im-a-pm.mjs render examples/video-api/flows.json --base examples/video-api/base.json --out examples/video-api/index.html && node skills/im-a-pm/scripts/im-a-pm.mjs diff examples/video-api/base.json examples/video-api/flows.json > examples/video-api/diff.txt && node skills/im-a-pm/scripts/im-a-pm.mjs trace publish-video --file examples/video-api/flows.json > examples/video-api/trace-publish-video.txt
scripts.check: npm run examples && git diff --exit-code --stat -- examples
